B=claude/evac-2026-11-20; MAIN=$HOME/lldvar; W=$HOME/wt_bsite_1123; R=$HOME/work/runs/b2o3_site_dft_2026_11_23; P=$HOME/work/pseudo_b2o3s9; PY=/home/kgy/apps/miniforge3/envs/uma/bin/python; PW=/home/kgy/apps/qe-7.4.1-gpu/bin/pw.x; RAW=$W/db/raw/ndo_site_2026_10_14/uma_modelc10_2026_10_16
( echo "== ① 소스 (대피 브랜치 · 새 worktree $W)" && { [ ! -e $W ] || { echo "⛔ $W 가 이미 있다"; false; }; } \
 && git -C $MAIN fetch -q origin $B && git -C $MAIN worktree add -q --detach $W FETCH_HEAD && git -C $W log --oneline -1 \
 && echo "== ② 도구 selftest (uma python)" && $PY $W/tools/doping/b2o3_site_dft.py --selftest | tail -1 | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q PASS \
 && echo "== ③ PP 6 개 (gabia 9 단계 것 · MD5 대조)" && mkdir -p $P \
 && for f in li_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF B.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF O.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.0.1.UPF P.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF s_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF cl_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF; do [ -s $P/$f ] || scp -q -o BatchMode=yes root@121.78.116.27:/data/work/pseudo/$f $P/ || exit 1; done \
 && ( cd $P && printf 'e912e257baa3777c20ea3d68f190483c  li_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF\n8c825a5969375aca5c2c6ad5945b3059  B.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF\n0234752ac141de4415c5fc33072bef88  O.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.0.1.UPF\n8b930f418f0a4573dca56cd030ffe088  P.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF\n88d86576ff6df21479756cfb9bdac1df  s_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF\nfc6f6913ecf08c9257cb748ef0700058  cl_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF\n' | md5sum -c - ) \
 && echo "== ④ O 를 B 옆으로 옮긴 조합 (239 개 기대)" && mkdir -p $R && $PY $W/tools/doping/b2o3_site_dft.py ob_pairs --raw $RAW --out $R/ob_combos | tail -1 \
 && echo "== ⑤ GPU 비었나 (다른 compute 프로세스가 있으면 멈춘다)" && A=$(nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader) && { [ -z "$A" ] || { echo "⛔ GPU 사용 중: $A"; false; }; } \
 && echo "== ⑥ DFT 메모리 프로브 — GPU pw.x 300 초 뒤 자동 종료 · run 아님 · 결과 안 씀 (BMP_04 128 원자 · k 3 3 1 · disk_io medium → nowf)" \
 && for D in medium nowf; do mkdir -p $R/probe_$D && $PY $W/tools/doping/b2o3_site_dft.py probe --xyz $RAW/structures/BMP_04.xyz --pseudo_dir $P --disk_io $D --out $R/probe_$D/scf.in > /dev/null \
      && ( O=$(ldd $PW) && M=$(echo "$O" | awk '/libmpi\.so/{print $3; exit}') && X=$(echo "$O" | awk '$3 ~ /^\//{print $3}' | xargs -r -n1 dirname | sort -u | tr '\n' ':') \
           && export OPAL_PREFIX=$(dirname $(dirname $M)) && export PATH=$OPAL_PREFIX/bin:$PATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(dirname $M):$X${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-} OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 GFORTRAN_UNBUFFERED_PRECONNECTED=y \
           && cd $R/probe_$D && B0=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits | head -1) \
           && { ( while :; do nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits | head -1; sleep 2; done ) > gpu.log 2>/dev/null & S=$!; \
                timeout 300 $OPAL_PREFIX/bin/mpirun --oversubscribe -np 1 $PW -nk 1 -in $R/probe_$D/scf.in > probe.out 2>&1; kill $S; pkill -f "$R/probe_$D/scf.in"; true; } \
           && echo "  [$D] GPU 최고 $(sort -n gpu.log | tail -1) MiB (시작 전 $B0) · SCF 반복 줄 $(grep -a -c 'iteration #' probe.out) 개" \
           && grep -a -E "number of k points|Estimated (max|total|static)|out of memory|Error" probe.out | head -5 | sed 's/^/    /'; rm -rf $R/probe_$D/tmp ) || exit 1; done \
 && echo "== ⑦ 조합 UMA 이완 발사 (이완만 · 10월 실행기 · tmux bsite_ob0)" \
 && { R=$R SRC=$W PY=$PY CAND=$R/ob_combos N_EXPECT=239 SESSION=bsite_ob0 OUTNAME=uma_ob_combos TIME_PS=0 TEMP=500 SEED=20261123 RELAX_FMAX=0.05 bash $W/db/inputs/ndo_site_2026_10_14/run_uma_kgy.sh > $R/launch_ob0.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -6 $R/launch_ob0.log; [ $rc = 0 ]; } \
) || echo "⛔ 멈췄다 — 마지막 '==' 줄이 멈춘 단계"
